question: How many stop-and-go events does vehicle v_964 experience? A stop-and-go event is counted each time the vehicle, having previously stopped (speed = 0.00 m/s) and then resumed moving (speed > 3 m/s), stops again (speed = 0.00 m/s). The initial stop is not counted — only subsequent stops after resuming. Answer format: <integer>
